issue.title: Issue opening COLLADA (.dae) exported from LeoCAD MPD model - issue with material transparency throughout
issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
Model generated using LeoCAD can be exported to various formats: Collada, 3DS and Wavefront (namely).

Exporting all three formats result in different results - and the Collada file does not open with F3D

I would also like to know why 3DS manages to render translucent parts but not Wavefront or Collada.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
 1. use f3d as file mimetype
 2. click on file to open and witness issues/variability
 3. Collada file stays blank

**Expected behavior**
Collada file (if exported properly) should parse and show on f3d - collada files seem to work fine as they are parsed and rendered on my website at https://legolinux.com

**System Information:**
![image](https://github.com/f3d-app/f3d/assets/5674757/1b8e1051-dbcf-4225-8c60-ceddf6c00a57)

**F3D Information**
f3d 1.3.1

F3D - A fast and minimalist 3D viewer
Version: 1.3.1.
Build date: 2022-09-07 10:08:43.
Build system: Linux x86_64.
Compiler: GNU 8.4.0.
External rendering module: ON.
Raytracing module: OFF.
Exodus module: ON.
OpenCASCADE module: 7.6.0 (no metadata).
Assimp module: 5.1.0.
Alembic module: 1.8.3.
VTK version: 9.2.20220821 (build 20220821).
Copyright (C) 2019-2021 Kitware SAS.
Copyright (C) 2021-2022 Michael Migliore, Mathieu Westphal.
License BSD-3-Clause.
By Michael Migliore, Mathieu Westphal and Joachim Pouderoux.


**Additional context**

If something is indeed wrong with file exports, i would need support to make dev understand that there is in fact something wrong - bug was dismissed on the premise that specs were respected to the tee

https://github.com/leozide/leocad/issues/797

Model files for reference:

![Screenshot_20230917_124733](https://github.com/f3d-app/f3d/assets/5674757/0a9bb79a-9c53-4660-a4e2-868eb22aefa3)

[models-exports.tar.gz](https://github.com/f3d-app/f3d/files/12643290/models-exports.tar.gz)

issue.title: Transparent colors need to be exported as transparent/alpha materials/shaders

repository.name: leocad
repository.description: A CAD application for creating virtual LEGO models

issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
Currently, none of the export formats seem to translate/export the LDRaw transparent colors with alpha transparency (at the very least)

All parts with that are assigned a transparent part color turn out solid when loaded into a viewer (blender, webgl, threejs or others)

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
open model
select part
assign transparent color from color palette
File > export > collada/3ds/wavefront

**Expected behavior**
colors with transparency/translucency should reflect at the very least with some alpha channel being enabled in the export file

**Screenshots**
![Screenshot_20220401_221225](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5674757/161361723-e0dd0eb3-1823-4944-938d-de6c7b98a82b.png)

**Version (please complete the following information):**
continuous - all

body: .3ds and .obj contained in [models-exports.tar.gz](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/files/12644942/models-exports.tar.gz) load OK, but can't load either .dae (from [cr-c75u2-close-combat.tar.gz](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/files/12644918/cr-c75u2-close-combat.tar.gz) or [models-exports.tar.gz](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/files/12644942/models-exports.tar.gz)) at all in my implementation; in my case there's a bounding box calculation that fails for the two .dae models due to invalide vertex value(s). Is it possible to try a different .dae exporter plugin? .3ds: .obj:

Just in case if it does help with this issue then consider these as a suggestion:

- My [ASSIMP Viewer](https://githubdragonfly.github.io/viewers/templates/ASSIMP%20Viewer.html), which is a ASSIMP(JS) / three.js hybrid, cannot show either of the DAE models
- My [DAE Viewer](https://githubdragonfly.github.io/viewers/templates/DAE%20Viewer.html), which is three.js based, can show both DAE models but can also:
  - re-export to DAE format, which makes the file 3 times bigger but readable by the ASSIMP Viewer
  - export to some other format (GLB is approximately the same size as the original DAE)

In case if you would like to experiment, both of the exports are attached below.

Just to point out that DAE Exporter used on my end might be obsolete.

[cr-c75u2-close-combat - DAE Export.zip](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/files/12707041/cr-c75u2-close-combat.-.DAE.Export.zip)
[cr-c75u2-close-combat - GLB Export.zip](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/files/12707042/cr-c75u2-close-combat.-.GLB.Export.zip)
The dae loader has an issue. Thanks for your report.

Attempting to load [`vf-171-nightmare-plus-gerwalk.dae`](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/files/12644942/models-exports.tar.gz) fails with error [`Not enough data for accessor`](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/blob/0ae66d27039481dc2a507bbc8482f691037c1a5a/code/AssetLib/Collada/ColladaParser.cpp#L1792)
